# CONCEPT logo motion reference

Observed: 2026-09-11
SHA-256: 8898b1c5ad2534bfe9da7a40c0f5de38b28b4c8277e69c98ac96160a488f07cd

The source JSON is byte-identical to the live reference. Its vector artwork spells UNIPLEX and is retained for the user-requested original-motion comparison, not a completed MILKY VEIL wordmark. No redistribution license is asserted.

The existing vendor script owns playback: seven precomposition instances, 24 fps, frames 0–92, non-looping; leaving the hero trigger starts playback, completion hides the stage. The runtime loader changes only background-colored fill/stroke colors to the computed CONCEPT surface. All path keyframes, timings, layer transforms and original CSS dimensions remain unchanged.
